b:
Searching for my lost
teenage years,
a journey with friends

The pages of life
I left behind
in the days when I was buried
in forests of books

Today
I am filling them in,
though the time has passed

Friendship said,
"Come out
past your circle"

Like a chakravaka bird
that has grown wings,
I go along with peacocks in full plumage

The hands of the clock
in the mirror of time

The rain will stop;
the heart will not

To be continued
note: The chakravaka is a bird of Indian poetry, said to live on moonlight and to long for its mate.
